master.format: WAV PCM signed 16-bit little-endian, 44100 Hz, stereo

license.evidence: Repository README.md: 'All assets, except those noted below, are under the CC0-1.0 license'; the only excepted assets are mago3.ttf and coin-flip.wav. assets/Formant_1.wav is not an exception.

encodes.format: AAC-LC 128 kbit/s in MP4/iPod muxer (writes iTunSMPB gapless metadata), 44100 Hz, stereo

audition.method: Objective signal analysis with ffprobe/ffmpeg 8.1.2 (duration, codec, silencedetect at -45 dB/0.15 s, sample-level loop-boundary RMS and discontinuity measurement on decoded PCM). Human listening confirmation on physical devices is deferred to the M4 device-validation gate; runtime_verified stays false until then.

candidates.evidence: No silence at either boundary (silencedetect found none); head/tail RMS 0.398/0.332 (stereo L) so energy flows across the join; the loop join lands on the track's own opening transient (max sample-to-sample delta 0.34 within the first 5 ms exists in the source track itself), so looping reproduces the native downbeat rather than adding a click; documented game background loop shipped in the source Godot template; CC0-1.0.

Tail RMS 0.011 vs head RMS 0.024: energy halves across the join, an audible dip every loop; MP3 encoder delay/padding adds sample-exact loop risk; generic production-music mood, weaker pulse/space fit.
Fade-out ending: tail RMS 0.0015 (effectively silent) vs head RMS 0.050; looping produces a dead gap every 91 s.
Silence gaps of 0.37 s, 0.27 s and 0.23 s inside the first second (silencedetect -45 dB/0.15 s); loop rhythm uneven at the join.

0.90 s leading silence and 0.19 s trailing silence: not seamless; 258 s would need ~47 kbit/s to fit the 1.5 MiB budget (unacceptable quality); CC BY 4.0 attribution burden; the same repository also hosts franchise remixes (Castlevania, Final Fantasy 7 arrangements), raising provenance-care requirements for no gain over the CC0 candidate.
